_description: Effect type definitions - what properties can be modified by effects
_notes: This file defines valid effect TYPE keywords
Actual named effects (poison, drunk, performance-high, etc.) are in game-data/effects/
Each effect type specifies what game property it modifies
Category determines what kind of modifiers are allowed:
- stat: Only CONSTANT modifiers (STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA) - active while effect is active
- capacity: Only CONSTANT modifiers (max_hp, max_mana, weight_capacity) - active while effect is active
- resource: INSTANT (one-time change), CONSTANT (while active), or PERIODIC (repeating) modifiers (hp, mana, hunger, fatigue)
- instant: Apply once immediately (or after delay) to resources - not tracked unless delayed
- constant: Stat/capacity modifiers active for full effect duration
- periodic: Repeating effects using tick_interval (resources only)

armor_class.description: Adds to armour class (read by combat and the Equipment tab)

unarmored_ac.description: Base AC (plus DEX) while no body armour is worn — mage armor; the higher of this and the gear's AC counts

armored_ac.description: Adds to armour class only while armour or a shield is worn (mending)

ac_floor.description: Armour class can't be lower than this (barkskin)

travel_speed.description: Travel speed, in percent (25 = 25% faster), multiplied with the Survival bonus

ambush_ward.description: When positive, a travel encounter can't open with you ambushed (alarm)

temp_hp.description: Temporary hit points you start each fight with while the effect lasts (false life, aid)

combat_move.description: Extra grid squares of movement per combat turn (longstrider)

combat_help.description: When positive, your first attack of each fight has advantage (a familiar's Help)

skill_athletics.description: Adds to the Athletics skill (checks, gates, locks, stealth, travel)

skill_crafting.description: Adds to the Crafting skill (checks, gates, locks, stealth, travel)

skill_influence.description: Adds to the Influence skill (checks, gates, locks, stealth, travel)

skill_medicine.description: Adds to the Medicine skill (checks, gates, locks, stealth, travel)

skill_perception.description: Adds to the Perception skill (checks, gates, locks, stealth, travel)

skill_resolve.description: Adds to the Resolve skill (checks, gates, locks, stealth, travel)

skill_survival.description: Adds to the Survival skill (checks, gates, locks, stealth, travel)

skill_thieving.description: Adds to the Thieving skill (checks, gates, locks, stealth, travel)
